intent_en: To illustrate the significant widening of the pay gap between American CEOs and workers over time.
previous_intent: To illustrate the dramatic widening of the pay gap between American CEOs and workers from 1965 to 2018.
narration_support: The pay gap between American CEOs and their workers has grown from 15 to 1 to 220 to 1 in less than a single lifetime.
chart_support: Line chart showing the ratio of CEO pay to worker pay increasing significantly from 1965 to 2018.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly states the growth of the pay gap over a lifetime, which is visually corroborated by the line chart showing a sharp rise in the ratio from 1965 to 2018.
